typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade Reference Identifier} as string,
		{Trade Reference Identifier Supplement} as string,
		{Sub-Product} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Buyer Name} as string,
		{ContraParty Firm account name} as string,
		{Counterparty Account Number} as string,
		{Fixed Rate} as string,
		{Fixed Rate Payer (Buyer) Swaption Buyer} as string,
		{Float Rate Payer (Seller) Swaption Seller} as string,
		{Reference Entity ID} as string,
		{Reference Entity Name} as string,
		{Scheduled Termination Date Expiration Date} as string,
		{Seller Name} as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Warehouse Current State Notional Amount} as string,
		{Warehouse Current State Notional Currency} as string,
		{Warehouse Insert Date} as string,
		{Warehouse Status} as string,
		{Warehouse Status Reason} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> File1ConMgr
File1ConMgr derive({Copy of Sub-Product} = {Sub-Product}) ~> DataConversion
File1ConMgr aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		Trade_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Trade_Reference_Identifier_Supplement as string,
		Fixed_Rate as integer,
		Warehouse_Insert_Date as string,
		Warehouse_Status as string,
		Counterparty_Account_Number as string,
		Float_Rate_Payer_Seller_Swaption_Seller as string,
		Warehouse_Current_State_Notional_Amount as integer,
		Sub_Product as string,
		Reference_Entity_Name as string,
		Seller_Name as string,
		Scheduled_Termination_Date_Expiration_Date as string,
		ContraParty_Firm_account_name as string,
		Buyer_Name as string,
		Fixed_Rate_Payer_Buyer_Swaption_Buyer as string,
		Trade_Reference_Identifier as string,
		Reference_Entity_ID as string,
		Warehouse_Status_Reason as string,
		Product_Type as string,
		Warehouse_Current_State_Notional_Currency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Trade_Date = {Trade Date},
		Trade_Reference_Identifier_Supplement = {Trade Reference Identifier Supplement},
		Fixed_Rate = {Copy of Fixed Rate},
		Warehouse_Insert_Date = {Warehouse Insert Date},
		Warehouse_Status = {Warehouse Status},
		Counterparty_Account_Number = {Counterparty Account Number},
		Float_Rate_Payer_Seller_Swaption_Seller = {Float Rate Payer (Seller) Swaption Seller},
		Warehouse_Current_State_Notional_Amount = {Copy of Warehouse Current State Notional Amount},
		Sub_Product = {Sub-Product},
		Reference_Entity_Name = {Reference Entity Name},
		Seller_Name = {Seller Name},
		Scheduled_Termination_Date_Expiration_Date = {Scheduled Termination Date Expiration Date},
		ContraParty_Firm_account_name = {ContraParty Firm account name},
		Buyer_Name = {Buyer Name},
		Fixed_Rate_Payer_Buyer_Swaption_Buyer = {Fixed Rate Payer (Buyer) Swaption Buyer},
		Trade_Reference_Identifier = {Trade Reference Identifier},
		Reference_Entity_ID = {Reference Entity ID},
		Warehouse_Status_Reason = {Warehouse Status Reason},
		Product_Type = {Product Type},
		Warehouse_Current_State_Notional_Currency = {Warehouse Current State Notional Currency}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
